title: Pure Shark
summary: Shark monsters and the WATER Xyz Monsters they climb into, with the Xyz Armor bridge and generic staples. Most Main Deck Sharks treat themselves as Level 3, 4, or 5 for a WATER Xyz Summon, and their effects lock you into WATER or Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Buzzsaw Shark targets a WATER monster you control (including itself) to Special Summon a Fish monster with the same Level and a different name from the Deck, such as Surfacing Big Jaws or Lantern Shark.
Surfacing Big Jaws Special Summons itself from the hand during a turn a Spell Card was activated and searches any Fish Shark monster on Normal or Special Summon.
Abyss Shark Special Summons itself while all monsters you control are WATER and searches a Level 3, 4, or 5 Fish monster (such as Drake Shark or Crystal Shark).
Veiss Shark Tributes a Fish monster on Normal or Special Summon to Special Summon a Fish Shark monster from the Deck, and grants a Shark Drake Xyz Monster a Quick Effect Spell/Trap negate.

summary.title: Opening: Buzzsaw Shark or Surfacing Big Jaws
steps: Normal Summon Buzzsaw Shark and activate its effect to Special Summon Surfacing Big Jaws from the Deck.
Use Surfacing Big Jaws to search Drake Shark, which immediately Special Summons itself from the hand on search and can be treated as two materials for a 3-material WATER Xyz.

Overlay into Number 32: Shark Drake (with Veiss Shark or Drake Shark attached) and rank up into Number C32: Shark Drake LeVeiss, while using the remaining Level 4 Sharks for Number 4: Stealth Kragen or Xyz Armor Fortress into Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer.

summary.title: Flexible Levels & Inherited Shark Drake Effects
summary.text: Buzzsaw Shark, Lantern Shark, Abyss Shark, Crystal Shark, Surfacing Big Jaws, and Hydrojet Shark can all be treated as Level 3, 4, or 5 when used for the Xyz Summon of a WATER monster. When Drake Shark and Veiss Shark are attached to a Shark Drake Xyz Monster (Number 32: Shark Drake or Number C32: Shark Drake LeVeiss), they grant it bonus Quick Effects to detach materials and negate Spell/Trap effects or shuffle Spell/Trap cards on the field into the Deck.

summary.title: WATER Xyz Bosses & Control
points: Number C32: Shark Drake LeVeiss overlays directly onto Number 32: Shark Drake by discarding a Spell, detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect on either turn to negate an opponent's monster and reduce its ATK/DEF to 0, and attacks twice with piercing.
Number 4: Stealth Kragen turns all face-up monsters on the field into WATER and destroys 1 WATER monster the opponent controls as a Quick Effect every turn while inflicting burn damage.
Xyz Armor Fortress overlays onto any Rank 3 or 4 Xyz, detaches materials to search cards, and ranks up into Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer to absorb an opponent's monster as Xyz Material.
Number S37: Spider Shark, Number 37: Hope Woven Dragon Spider Shark, Number 73: Abyss Splash, Number 94: Crystalzero, and Shark Fortress round out the Rank 4 and Rank 5 WATER lineup.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Bahamut Shark is Forbidden in the TCG and is excluded from the Extra Deck.
